title: Project Manager
description:
Who You Are



We’re looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Project Manager Associate with 3–5 years of experience in project management within the tech industry. You thrive in fast-paced environments, have strong communication and organizational skills, and are comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously. Experience in electronic security or low-voltage systems is a strong advantage.



What You’ll Do



Manage end-to-end project lifecycles from site visit through installation and completion

Coordinate with internal teams, subcontractors, and third-party security integrators

Schedule and oversee site visits, installations, and subcontracting activities

Build and maintain strong relationships with partners, subcontractors, and customers

Track project progress and communicate updates to stakeholders, including executives

Prepare and maintain job plans, specifications, work orders, and project documentation

Produce accurate estimates for materials, labor, repairs, and installations

Handle procurement and fulfillment of hardware requirements

Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and meet quality standards

Monitor multiple projects across various locations in the U.S.

Negotiate with subcontractors and partners to optimize costs and outcomes

Maintain installation schedules and ensure efficient resource allocation

Ensure customer satisfaction by monitoring subcontractor performance

Close out projects with proper documentation, including invoices and completion records



What We’re Looking For



3–5 years of project management experience in a tech company

Strong verbal and written communication skills

Excellent time management and organizational abilities

Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills

Highly detail-oriented with strong problem-solving capabilities



Nice to Have:



Experience in electronic security or low-voltage systems

Background in field-based installation or project coordination

Knowledge of access control, video surveillance, or intrusion detection systems

Experience estimating for commercial or multifamily security projects



What We Offer



Work From Home: Fully remote setup with local support

Generous Paid Time Off: Start with 18 paid leaves annually

U.S. Holiday Observance: Enjoy U.S. holidays off

Free HMO Coverage: Premium healthcare access at no cost

Professional Environment: Join a supportive, growth-oriented global team

title: TikTok Shop Affiliate Campaigns Specialist (Remote)
description:
We are hiring a TikTok Shop Affiliate Campaigns Specialist for a TikTok-native agency that manages affiliate programmes for global consumer brands. Our client runs a network of 5,000+ verified affiliates and generates tens of millions in TikTok-attributed revenue for major brands.



You will own the affiliate engine. Recruit creators, build and optimise campaigns inside TikTok Shop, track performance, and scale affiliate sales across the client portfolio.



This is a revenue function, not a support function. Every creator you onboard, every campaign you optimise, and every commission you refine has a direct line to client results.



What You Will Do:



- Source, screen, and onboard TikTok Shop affiliates. Build the creator pipeline.

- Set up and manage affiliate campaigns inside TikTok Shop end to end

- Create, optimise, and maintain affiliate links and commission structures

- Monitor clicks, sales, ROI, and conversions. Analyse the data and act on it.

- Communicate with and support creators as their primary point of contact

- Troubleshoot tracking, payout, and campaign setup issues

- Develop strategies to grow affiliate revenue for client brands

- (Bonus) Assist with TikTok Shop product listings, store setup, and backend ops when needed



Must-Have Requirements:



- 1+ years managing TikTok Shop affiliate campaigns (mandatory, non-negotiable)

- Hands-on experience with TikTok Shop's Affiliate Center tools

- Experience managing a high volume of creators and multiple client accounts at the same time

- Strong understanding of TikTok Shop's affiliate ecosystem and how it drives revenue

- Comfortable analysing performance metrics (clicks, sales, ROI, conversions) and optimising accordingly

- Excellent written English and proactive communication

- Comfortable with spreadsheets, dashboards, and internal tools

- Experience working with US market clients

- Available during US working hours overlap



Nice to Have:



- TikTok Shop backend / Seller Center experience (product listings, store setup)

- Experience with TikTok Shop in multiple regions

- Previous agency-side experience



You Will Thrive Here If:



- You build relationships naturally. Creators trust you because you follow through.

- You spot underperforming campaigns before anyone flags them

- You thrive managing dozens of creators and multiple campaigns at once without things slipping

- TikTok Shop affiliate tools are second nature to you, not a learning curve

- You communicate proactively. Creators and internal teams never need to chase you.

- You enjoy working in the creator economy



This Role Is NOT For You If:



- You have never used TikTok Shop's affiliate tools (this is a hard requirement)

- You prefer working on one project at a time

- You are not comfortable reaching out to new creators regularly

- You do not enjoy working with data and metrics

- You need heavy supervision on day-to-day priorities

title: Commercial Real Estate Appraisal Analyst
description:
**IMPORTANT**

To apply for this role, only use this link:





Direct messages via onlinejobs.ph are not accepted.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Location: Remote (US hours)    



Type: Full-Time



Hours: 4:00 AM – 1:00 PM CST, Monday to Friday



Salary: PHP 80,000 – PHP 110,000 (PHP 100,000 – PHP 140,000 for MAI candidacy or proven US CRE track record)



 



About Pahroo



Pahroo Appraisal and Consultancy delivers commercial real estate valuations and advisory services across US markets, with a focus on assets underlying debt and equity investments. We work across office, industrial, multifamily, self-storage, and retail. The team is small, the work is rigorous, and the standards are high.



Working Hours — Please Read Before Applying

This role operates on US Central Standard Time: 4:00 AM – 1:00 PM CST, Monday to Friday. If you are based outside the US, please confirm this works for your circumstances before applying. It is a firm requirement.



The Role



You will sit within the valuation team, producing and supporting appraisal reports across a mixed commercial portfolio. The work is analytical, deadline-driven, and detail-critical. Once onboarded, you will be expected to work with a real degree of independence, drawing on sound US market knowledge to produce defensible value conclusions.



This is not an entry-level position. We need someone who understands why a number is what it is, not just how to arrive at it.



What You Will Do



 - Conduct research using industry databases — CoStar, REIS, RCA, PwC Real Estate Investor Survey, and broker market reports — to gather and interrogate comparable market evidence

 - Analyse property-level financial data including income statements, rent rolls, reimbursement schedules, and occupancy statistics to develop well-supported value indicators

 - Prepare collateral monitoring reports for assets underlying debt and equity investments across office, industrial, multifamily, self-storage, retail, and other property types

 - Produce USPAP-compliant appraisal reports ready for lender, investor, or regulatory review

 - Identify data gaps and market anomalies; flag assumptions that materially affect value conclusions

 - Manage competing report deadlines accurately without compromising on quality

 



What We Need



Required



 - Minimum 5 years of commercial real estate appraisal or valuation experience

 - Demonstrated, hands-on experience in the US property market — no learning curve on market fundamentals

 - Proficiency in ANOW, Total, and Excel-based valuation modelling

 - Working knowledge of USPAP requirements and their practical application in report preparation

 - Bachelor’s degree in Real Estate, Finance, Economics, or a closely related field

 - Strong written English — reports require clear, accurate, and defensible reasoning

 



Advantageous



 - MAI designation (Appraisal Institute) or active candidacy

 - RICS membership — relevant for internationally-based candidates with demonstrable US market exposure

 - Familiarity with CoStar, REIS, or RCA analytics platforms

 - Experience across two or more distinct asset classes

 



What We Offer



 - Base salary PHP 80,000 – PHP 110,000 per month

 - PHP 100,000 – PHP 140,000 for candidates with MAI candidacy or a demonstrable US CRE track record across multiple asset classes — we pay up for the right experience

 - Fully remote position

 - Clear onboarding with defined expectations from day one



**IMPORTANT**

To apply for this role, only use this link: 





Direct messages via onlinejobs.ph are not accepted.

title: Senior Real Estate Appraisal Coordinator
description:
**ONLY APPLY VIA THE LINK PROVIDED BELOW. DM'S SENT ON ONLINE JOBS WILL NOT BE RESPONDED TO**



If you’ve worked inside a US Appraisal Management Company and you know the difference between a 1004 and a Field Review, a TAT and a due date extension, an ENB file and a standard PDF delivery — this role was written for you.

We’re not looking for someone we need to teach the industry. We’re looking for someone who already speaks it fluently and is ready to own it.



Senior Appraisal Coordinator



Company: Pahroo Appraisal and Consultancy, LLC - Chicago USA.

Location: Remote (US hours)

Type: Full-Time

Hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST, Monday to Friday

Salary: PHP 55,000 – PHP 95,000



ABOUT PAHROO

PahRoo Appraisal & Consultancy LLC is a Chicago-based real estate appraisal firm operating across residential and commercial markets in Illinois and Texas. We work with AMCs, direct lenders, and private clients, and we are growing — deliberately and with the right people.



We run a ROWE culture: Results Only Work Environment. We don’t count hours. We count outcomes. If you’re a professional who delivers without being micromanaged, you’ll thrive here.



THE ROLE

This is a senior front office position with real ownership. You will be the operational engine of our Appraisal Operations Department — the person who keeps orders moving, clients updated, appraisers scheduled, and nothing falling through the cracks.



You’ll work directly with our Appraisal Operations Manager, hold independent decision-making authority on day-to-day coordination, and play a hands-on role in shaping how our front office runs as we scale.



This is not a task-ticker role. It is a thinking role for someone who takes pride in running a tight operation.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN

– Full order lifecycle management across ANOW — from bid acceptance through report delivery and closure

– Independent bid decisions on standard residential assignments; zero waiting on someone else to move your queue

– Inspection scheduling and appraiser route optimization for our Chicago and Dallas markets

– Outreach calling and pipeline management across our AMC and direct client accounts

– Report delivery via AMC portals in all required formats — PDF, XML, ENB

– Revision management end-to-end — you communicate, you track, you close

– Zoho CRM ownership for outreach tracking and lead pipeline management

– Keeping ANOW audit-ready at all times — data integrity is non-negotiable here



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

– Minimum 2 years of experience in a US AMC, appraisal office, or appraisal management environment — this is a hard requirement, not a preference

– Working knowledge of US residential appraisal order types: 1004/URAR, FHA, Field Review, New Construction, Desktop

– Hands-on experience with ANOW or a comparable appraisal CRM (Mercury Network, Appraisal Inbox, etc.)

– Professional written and spoken English — you are client-facing from day one

– The ability to manage 20+ active orders simultaneously without losing your composure or your accuracy

– Availability to work full CST business hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM, Monday to Friday

– CRM experience in Zoho, Salesforce, or equivalent is a strong advantage



WHAT YOU GET

– PHP 55,000–95,000/month commensurate with experience — a senior rate for a senior hire

– Full-time, long-term contractor engagement — this is a career position, not a project

– Direct access to a senior leadership team actively investing in the right systems and the right people

– Deep, specialized expertise in the US appraisal market — one of the most defensible and transferable skill sets in offshore real estate operations

– A ROWE culture — your results define your day, not a timesheet



START DATE

Immediate. We are moving quickly on this hire and interviewing on a rolling basis. If you are the right person, we will not wait.

title: Supply Chain Specialist
description:
Supply Chain Specialist – E-commerce

Join Our Growing supply chain team at Roots & Branches

Hi there! We're on the lookout for an experienced Supply Chain Specialist who knows what it takes to run a tight replenishment operation — especially for Amazon and multi-channel e-commerce businesses. Do you thrive on managing inventory and getting products on time against the lowest costs to our sales channels? Then we’d love to meet you.



________________________________________



About Roots & Branches

At Roots & Branches, we are passionate about enhancing well-being through high-quality health products. As a fast-growing European brand group, we sell across Amazon, our own webshops & Bol with our 5 different brands. But well-being doesn't stop at our customers, we care just as much about our team. That's why we invest in our company culture through regular personal calls where we stay connected as people, not just colleagues. And to keep everything running smoothly behind the scenes, a strong, reliable supply chain is critical to our success and that's where you come in.



________________________________________



About the role

In this role you will report directly to the senior supply chain coordinator for operational questions, who is based in The Philippines as well. Next to that, you’re in direct contact with the supply chain manager about possible improvements and projects. Mondays and Tuesdays tend to be the busiest days of the week due to creation of the replenishments. The other remaining days you will be monitoring shipments, collecting data and improving processes. We’re seeking for a pro active colleague that is constantly searching for improvements. Preferably that colleague has experience with AI as we want to minimize the repetitive tasks.





What You’ll Do



You'll support and strengthen our Supply Chain department with responsibilities like:

• Replenishment Management

Plan and execute shipments to Amazon FBA and Bol warehouses across Europe, United States and United Kingdom.

• Data management

Make sure that the data that we use to make decisions is accurate. This varies from monitoring direct D2C shipments, shipping costs as well as following up on reimbursements

• Inventory Monitoring

Track stock levels across multiple platforms to prevent stockouts and overstocking.

• Issue Resolution & Stress-resistant

Communicate clearly and promptly with warehouses, logistics providers, and internal teams to solve any supply chain hiccups.

________________________________________

What We’re Looking For

• 3+ years in supply chain operations, preferably in an e-commerce and Amazon FBA environment.

• Someone that is eager to learn and that is able to manage their own tasks individually.

• Strong experience with replenishment planning and inventory management across multiple channels.

• Excellent English communication skills — written and spoken.

• Proficient in Google Sheets, Excel, or similar tools (bonus for experience with inventory management systems).

• Someone that is willing to work till 10 / 11 PM to create overlap with our Europe team (this means you will start in the afternoon)

Mindset

• Highly organized and detail-oriented.

• Proactive problem solver — you spot issues before they escalate.

• Team player who communicates openly and takes ownership of responsibilities.

• Flexible and fast — you’re comfortable working in an environment where priorities can shift.

• Always looking for improving current processes. Preferably in combination with AI.



Bonus Points (not required but nice to have)

• Experience with inventory planning software (e.g., Inventory Planner, Cin7, NetSuite, etc.).

• Worked at an e-commerce aggregator, brand, or agency.

________________________________________

What We Offer

• A fast-growing, entrepreneurial environment where your ideas and work have real impact.

• Salary in the range of $900 - $1200 per month + performance-based bonuses.

• Full-time, fully remote role (Philippines-based applicants preferred).

We work with combat athletes and high performers across Australia and are looking for someone who can consistently start conversations, build relationships, and book qualified calls through Instagram.



Your Responsibilities:

- Send outbound messages to targeted athletes daily

- Respond to incoming messages and enquiries

- Build genuine conversations (not spam)

Performance bonuses available based on appointments booked and clients signed

title: Scheduler and Payroll and Billing Specialist for a Home Care Agency
description:
Company Summary:

Comfort Keepers has been serving central and northern New Hampshire for over 20 years. We are locally owned and operated. This award-winning company has a passion for helping clients and employees elevate the human spirit by providing home care both non-medical and medical. 



We are looking for a dependable and detail-oriented homecare Scheduler/call Intake to manage caregiver and client schedules, handling all inbound calls, serving as a knowledgeable first point of contact for prospective clients and families for our US-based home care operations. This role plays a key part in ensuring accurate scheduling, timely communication, and high-quality service delivery while maintaining confidentiality and compliance.



A Payroll and Billing Specialist manages employee compensation and client invoices, ensuring accurate, timely paychecks and revenue collection. Key duties include processing time sheets, calculating taxes, deductions, and commissions, generating invoices, and resolving discrepancies. They ensure compliance with financial regulations and maintain detailed records using accounting software.



Key Responsibilities for Scheduler:

* Create, manage, and update schedules for caregivers

* Coordinate client schedules based on care plans and staff availability

* Communicate daily schedule changes with caregivers, clients, and healthcare personnel

* Maintain accurate staff and client records in scheduling and database systems

* Ensure scheduling systems are accurate and up to date

* Escalate scheduling conflicts to the Manager

* Build professional relationships with clients to ensure excellent service delivery

* Perform general administrative and office support tasks as needed

* Answer, screen, and direct all incoming calls in a professional and timely manner

* Accurately transfer calls to the appropriate staff member

* Document all call activity, client inquiries, and scheduling changes in the agency's software system

* Communicate clearly with caregivers, clients, family members, and office staff

* Support staff by relaying intake information and pre-qualifying prospective client calls

* Maintain confidentiality and comply with HIPAA guidelines at all times



Key Responsibilities for Payroll and Billing Specialist:

*Payroll Processing - Collect, review, and input employee time sheets                                          

*Billing & Invoicing - Create, verify, and send client invoices, manage accounts receivable, and track outstanding balances.

*Record Maintenance - Update employee information, including salary changes, benefits deductions, and exemptions, in payroll systems.

*Problem Solving - Resolve pay inaccuracies and billing disputes to maintain employee satisfaction and client trust.

*Reporting - Prepare reports for management regarding payroll expenses and billing data.



Preferred Skills and Qualifications:

*Experience : 1–3 years of experience in scheduling. Can train for payroll and billing tasks.

*Education : Bachelor’s degree 

*Software Proficiency : Familiarity with the scheduling system eRSP is a big plus. Familiarity with any home care scheduling system is great along with payroll/accounting software like Viventium. 

*Analytical Skills : Strong attention to detail and accuracy is a must!

*Communication : Strong verbal and written communication skills for employee and client inquiries.

*Ability to multitask and work under pressure in a fast-paced environment

*Strong organizational, time-management, and communication skills



Why You’ll Love Working with Us:

*Make a Difference: You’ll play a key role in ensuring that employees are satisfied and clients receive the best care possible.

*Growth Opportunities: As we grow, so will you! There’s plenty of room for advancement and learning.

*Fun & Supportive Team: We’re a tight-knit group that values collaboration, compassion, and a good laugh.



If you’re excited about the opportunity to join our team, where you’ll be appreciated, have a sense of purpose and inclusion and are willing to help us create a brighter, more compassionate care experience, we can’t wait to hear from you! Apply today and let’s make a difference together.

title: TikTok Media Buyer -  Paid Ads & Performance Marketing (Remote)
description:
We are hiring a TikTok Media Buyer for a TikTok-native agency that manages paid media for global consumer brands. The agency manages $250M+ in annual ad spend across 100+ clients, including major brands you would recognise. The full client list and agency name will be shared once we connect.



This is a performance marketing role. You will plan, launch, and optimise TikTok ad campaigns end-to-end for the agency's client portfolio. You will work directly with the performance team, own daily optimisation, and report monthly on results.

This is NOT an organic content or strategy role. It is hands-on paid media execution for someone who lives inside campaign data.



What You Will Do:



- Plan and launch TikTok ad campaigns from scratch - targeting, bidding, creative selection, budgets, and scheduling

- Monitor performance daily - ROAS, CPA, CPL, CTR, engagement and optimise in real time

- Run structured A/B tests on creatives, audiences, and campaign structures

- Build and expand custom and lookalike audiences for retargeting and prospecting

- Turn performance data into clear optimisation decisions and execute them

- Deliver clean monthly performance reports with KPIs, insights, and recommendations by the 2nd of every month

- Manage multiple client campaigns at the same time without losing structure



Must-Have Requirements:



- Strong hands-on experience managing paid media campaigns, ideally TikTok Ads or other performance platforms (Meta, Google)

- High analytical fluency - comfortable with data, metrics, and budget management at speed

- Experience with audience segmentation, retargeting funnels, and lookalike audience creation

- Excellent attention to detail in campaign structure, naming conventions, and budget allocation

- Self-starter - proactive, reliable, comfortable working independently and remotely

- Comfortable managing multiple campaigns and client priorities at the same time

- Strong written English



Nice to Have:



- Direct TikTok Ads Manager experience at scale

- Experience running campaigns for ECommerce or DTC brands

- Familiarity with TikTok Shop ads (GMV Max, Video Shopping Ads)



You Will Thrive Here If:



- You think in ROAS, CPA, and CTR before you think in impressions

- You know what "optimise daily" actually means in practice

- You are self-directed and don't need someone checking in to keep you productive

- You stay ahead of TikTok platform updates and new ad formats

- You can translate raw data into a clear story for non-technical clients



This Role Is NOT For You If:



- You prefer organic content or creative strategy over paid performance

- You need detailed daily briefs to know what to work on

- You are uncomfortable making budget decisions independently

- You have not worked in a fast-paced, results-driven environment

- You are not interested in going deep on the TikTok Ads platform

title: SEO + Analytics + Attribution Specialist / Operator (GA4 / GSC · GoHighLevel · multi-stack)
description:
We're hiring a remote SEO + analytics operator to own the full loop, from search position to GA4 conversion to CRM/GHL-tracked revenue, across a small book of clients. You run the weekly rhythm, flag what's off, and shape how we work. You work closely with the strategy director.

Understanding attribution is the heart of it. You'll know which content piece produced which lead, which course registration, which revenue, because you'll have set up GA4 in each client's stack and designed the attribution architecture with them from day one.



Our setup:

We build client sites on Webflow + GoHighLevel, or custom code (Astro + Sanity, built with Claude Code) + GoHighLevel, and some clients run on WordPress. So you work across a mixed stack, and the constant is the analytics/attribution layer, which is platform-agnostic. Every client runs inside our proprietary AI-built content + SEO pipeline (contenttracker). Your primary stack: GSC, GA4, GTM, Keyword Planner, Google Trends, Keywords Everywhere + our own tooling. Lean by design, not a gap.



What you'll do:

-Run the weekly content-performance rhythm in contenttracker per client: GSC review, GA4 conversions review, keyword-zone management, 1–2 content briefs per client per week.

-Set up GA4 + GTM from scratch for each client and own the attribution architecture: first-touch UTM preservation, event / form / calendar tracking, cross-domain, custom fields, reporting backbone.

-Spec the tracking for whoever implements it: the developer (in code, e.g. Astro/Webflow) and the client's GHL team, then verify it end-to-end (UTM captured to contact created to correct tags to first-touch locked to GA4 event fired). You design, spec and verify; you don't write the site code or build inside GHL.

-Run UTM + attribution hygiene across client stacks.

-Keep course-date copy current against a named source of truth.

-Monthly cross-domain review for clients in multi-brand ecosystems.

-Produce monthly client reports.

-Shape contenttracker, our proprietary tool in the making propose and spec improvements; we ship what you spec.



You're a good fit if:

-You can set up a GA4 property from scratch, configure conversions, set up UTMs, and explain what you did to a non-technical business owner in plain English.

-GTM and cross-domain tracking are core for you. Installing/configuring containers, events, and cross-domain measurement across multiple related properties (not just "basic snippets").

-You're fluent in Google Search Console, and in technical SEO on code / headless sites as well as visual builders — crawlability and rendering, sitemaps, schema-in-code, canonicals, redirects, hreflang.

-You can explain first-touch vs last-touch attribution, why it matters and when to use which.

-You understand GHL hands-on (custom fields, workflows, form tracking, funnels) well enough to spec it for the GHL team — they implement; you design and verify.

-You think in funnels, not keywords. A page ranking #3 that doesn't convert is a CTA/intent problem.

-LLM Search experience: you know how to get content cited by ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity.

-You're comfortable specifying for developers and verifying their output. You work with a dev, not instead of one.

Fluent written and spoken English. Ownership mindset.



Nice to have



-Headless CMS (Sanity) familiarity — content models and SEO fields.

-Astro / JAMstack experience.

-Content migration: 301 mapping, pruning, preserving search equity (we migrate sites that already have rankings).



Growth trajectory : You may move into client-facing work; the role grows into a head-of-SEO-operations function.



About us: Amsterdam-based content practice, 20+ years of strategic and creative work, B2B and SMB clients including training practices where the gap between €1,000 and €5,000/month of content-driven revenue is genuinely transformative. We work for companies that inspire.



Process : (1) 5 candidates interviewed; (2) Two candidates do one compact paid assignment (~4 hrs, full rate) mixing a GA4/attribution hands-on task + an attribution-audit case; (3) long-term collaboration after onboarding.



How to apply :A thought-through reply + 2 clear use cases (ideally one GA4/attribution setup, one content-driven SEO result). Generic replies won't be answered; we verify use cases before shortlisting.

title: Video Editor (Paid Ad Creatives)
description:
Hey there! We're Hest Enterprises — an eCommerce brand that is scaling globally.



We're looking for a Video Editor to join our fast growing team.



Your mission? Collaborate with our Creative Strategist & Copywriter to produce ad creatives that actually convert and help scale our brands to multiple 7 figures+.



Important! If you have zero interest in learning why ads work (not just making them look pretty), this role isn't for you. But if you're hungry to learn marketing while sharpening your editing skills...



Who We're Looking For



One golden rule at our company: you must have the DESIRE to learn & grow. If you're not passionate about getting better every week, this isn't the place for you.



The purpose of this role isn't just editing videos — it's learning how to edit for performance. You'll learn how hooks grab attention, how emotional pacing drives watch time, and how the right angle maximizes ROAS. We'll train you on the marketing side — you bring the hunger.



You're a great fit if you:



- Love editing videos and want to get seriously good at it

- Are curious about what makes ads actually convert

- Take feedback well and move fast on revisions

- Are organized, reliable, and detail-oriented

- Want to grow into a Creative Strategist role over time (not necessary)



What You'll Do Day-to-Day



- Edit short-form video ads (UGC, product clips, b-roll)

- Assemble ads using provided scripts, briefs, and reference examples

- Add text overlays, captions, cuts, and pacing optimized for ads

- Create variations from the same core footage for testing

- Help document ad structure in simple briefs (hook, message, CTA)

- Make revisions based on internal feedback

- Keep files and exports organized for the team

- Attend weekly learning check-ins



Required:



- Experience with Video Editing ads (CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar)

- Clear written English

- Ability to follow instructions and hit deadlines

- Open & Curious to Feedback and Revisions

- Organised and reliable



Why Join Us?



- Bonuses & Profit Share — You'll earn bonuses tied to the performance of ads you help create. When your work converts, you get rewarded.

- Real Training — Not just video editing. We'll train you on ad structures, creative strategy, and how to edit for results. You'll learn marketing fundamentals most junior editors never get exposed to.

- Growth Path — There's a clear path from Junior Editor ? Creative Strategist based on performance. We promote from within.



How Does This Work?



We hold our team to high standards and reward great work — expect your rates to grow as you do. Here's our simple hiring process:



- Send a short intro video about yourself and your experience,

- A portfolio or samples of video edits (ads preferred)

- Culture and Values Interview

- Complete a quick editing assessment tailored for the role

- Final interview with our Founder to discuss fit and finalize an offer



If this resonates with you, let's chat! Choose the number of the core value you feel aligns with you most and include it in your application:



1 - RESULTS OBSESSED

2 - ATTENTION TO DETAIL

3 - ACCELERATED EXCELLENCE

4 - RELENTLESS OWNERSHIP

5 - PREPARED TO WIN

6 - COLLABORATIVE INNOVATION

7 - NEVER NOT GROWING



Apply now and let's grow together!

title: Funnel Builder (Funnelish) — Remote / Full-Time

We are a fast-growing health and wellness snack food brand. We are seeking a highly capable Executive Assistant, Accounting & Business Coordinator to create structure, reduce founder admin load, and keep day-to-day workflows moving smoothly across sales, operations, accounting, and brand support. This is a cross-functional, high-trust role designed for a positive, energetic operator who thrives in a fast-moving, founder-led environment and comfortably wears multiple hats. 



Part time (20 hours per week)

Central Timezone



Key Responsibilities

1.	Executive & Founder Support

•	Manage daily inbox triage, surface priority communications, and draft routine replies.

•	Route incoming customer opportunities from platforms like Opener to the right tea
mbers. 

•	Assist with EDI-related admin workflows and manage inbound customer/retailer messages. 

•	Handle customer-facing social messages and support lightweight social posting workflows. 



Required Skills & Experience

•	Experience: 3+ years of strong experience supporting executive-level management. Experience in venture capital, private equity, legal, or banking is highly desired. 

•	Industry Knowledge: Significant experience working within the consumer packaged food and beverage (CPG) space, including e-commerce. 

•	Systems & Tech: Deep proficiency in advanced Excel, Cin7 Core (DEAR), QuickBooks, and Shopify. 

•	Communication: Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills. 

•	Education: Bachelor's degree required; a business degree is preferred. 

•	Core Traits: Problem solver with keen judgment, high resilience under high expectations, and a roll-up-your-sleeves approach. 



To Apply

title: Logistics Support Officer – European Operations
description:

* Coordinate import/export documentation and shipment status reporting

* Communicate with internal teams and external logistics partners to ensure smooth operations

* Previous experience in logistics, supply chain support, freight coordination, or operations administration

* Strong organizational and follow-up skills

* Excellent attention to detail and ability to multitask

* Strong communication skills and professional
/phone etiquette

* Fluent English communication skills are required

* Ability to work European business hours

* Experience with shipment tracking systems, spreadsheets, and logistics software

* Basic understanding of import/export or freight operations is advantageous

* Experience supporting European logistics or distribution operations

* Knowledge of dangerous goods or gas cylinder logistics is an advantage

* Multilingual skills, including Polish, German, or other European languages, are highly advantageous

* Experience working with freight forwarders and warehouse operations

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in logistics support or operations administration



This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated logistics professional seeking to grow within an international European operations environment.

title: SEO Manager (Healthcare Clients) – Pulse Digital Health
description:
About Pulse Digital Health

Pulse Digital Health is a specialist digital agency working exclusively within the health and wellness sector. We help clinics, health-tech brands, and wellbeing companies grow their online presence with clarity, credibility, and compliance. We believe good health information should be easy to find — and we're building the team to make that happen at scale.



The Role

We're hiring an SEO Manager to lead our organic search strategy across a portfolio of health and wellness clients. This is a next-generation SEO role — you'll be responsible not just for traditional rankings, but for ensuring our clients' content surfaces in AI-generated answers, generative search experiences, and across the full modern search landscape.

You'll be a voice in the agency, working closely with content, development, and client teams. You won't just identify what needs to change — you'll own making it happen.



Key Responsibilities



AI & Generative Search Optimisation

- Lead the agency's GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation) and AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation) strategy across client accounts

- Optimise client content to appear in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other LLM-powered surfaces

- Build and maintain structured content formats (FAQs, lists, schema) that improve citability in AI-generated responses

- Monitor brand presence and citation frequency across AI search tools and report on AI visibility as a KPI





Technical SEO

- Conduct comprehensive technical SEO audits covering crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, site architecture, and structured data

- Partner with development teams to implement technical recommendations quickly and correctly

- Manage and improve E-E-A-T signals across health client sites — a non-negotiable in the medical and wellness space

- Stay current with algorithm updates and assess their impact on client performance proactively





Strategy, Reporting & Client Management

- Own SEO performance reporting across accounts — connecting organic visibility to business outcomes (leads, revenue, conversions)

- Present insights and recommendations to clients clearly, translating technical findings into plain business language

- Run A/B and SEO experiments, document outcomes, and use results to shape ongoing strategy

- Manage agency relationships with third-party tools, platforms, and freelancers where relevant





What We're Looking For



Essential

4+ years of hands-on SEO experience in a full-time position

Demonstrable understanding of AI-driven search (GEO, AEO, LLM visibility) — not just awareness, but applied experience

Strong technical SEO skills: site audits, Core Web Vitals, schema markup, log file analysis

Experience building content strategies backed by keyword research, intent mapping, and gap analysis

Proficiency with core SEO tools: Google Search Console, Semrush or Ahrefs, Screaming Frog

Strong data literacy — able to pull, interpret, and present data confidently (SQL a plus)

Excellent written and verbal communication; able to brief, present, and influence stakeholders at all levels

Project management skills — comfortable running multiple accounts simultaneously without dropping the ball





Highly Desirable

Experience in the health, medical, or wellness sector (understanding of E-E-A-T and YMYL content is a significant advantage)

Familiarity with digital PR and link acquisition strategies

Experience with prompt engineering and AI workflow tooling (e.g. Claude, Perplexity, Jasper, or similar)

Knowledge of HTML, CSS, or JavaScript basics — enough to speak fluently with developers

Agency background preferred, but strong in-house candidates with multi-brand experience are equally welcome





What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days, you'll have completed audits across our core client accounts, identified quick wins and longer-term strategic opportunities, and established a clear AI visibility baseline for each client.



At 6 months, you'll be leading strategy independently, running experiments, and presenting results that tie SEO performance directly to client business goals. You'll have introduced at least one AI/GEO-forward initiative that's measurably moved the needle.



Longer term, you'll be a senior voice shaping how Pulse thinks about the future of search — helping to define our service offering as the landscape evolves.



Please note, this is a full-time role and we are looking for someone who can commit to this as their main role. In your proposal, please include your salary expectation per month (we work 40 hours per week and have paid holidays covered as well as part of the contract).



Very important: You will be expected not to have any other jobs that you will be carrying out at the same time as this one.

title: Meta Ads Funnel Optimization & Technical Performance Marketing Specialist (Meta Ads, GTM, Pixel/CAPI)
description:
**Important: This role requires mandatory availability and responsiveness during our core business hours of 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Standard Time (PST); please only apply if you can commit to this schedule.**



 



PLEASE complete your application form below.



This helps us get to know you better, organize our candidate list, and speeds up the hiring process. 



 



***ONLY applicants who complete this form will be considered!!***







 



 



[[[   Who we’re looking for   ]]]



  



We’re looking for a hands-on technical performance marketing specialist to help us fix, optimize, and scale our paid acquisition funnels.



 



The immediate focus is Meta Ads infrastructure: Pixel, Conversions API, GTM, event tracking, custom conversions/events, and attribution accuracy. Longer term, we want someone who can help build and improve funnels across additional channels such as Google Ads, landing pages, analytics, and conversion tracking systems.



 



This is not a general social media role. We need someone who is strong technically and can diagnose how tracking, attribution, and funnel structure affect ad performance.



    



[[[   Who You Are   ]]]



 



- A "Manager of One": You are self-driven, organized, and solve problems efficiently without needing constant supervision.



- Remote-Ready: You have a proven track record of maintaining high visibility in asynchronous environments like ClickUp and Slack.



- Detail-Oriented: You have an exceptional eye for design and aesthetics, ensuring that every pixel aligns with our brand standards.



- Reliable: You understand "Baton Pass" reliability—when you finish a task, you update the status and notify the next person immediately to prevent project stalls.



 



 



[[[   Skills & Qualifications   ]]]



 



We are looking for someone with strong hands-on experience in:



 



Meta Ads Manager campaign setup, optimization, and troubleshooting

Meta Pixel setup, testing, and debugging

Meta Conversions API, including server-side tracking and event deduplication

Google Tag Manager, including tags, triggers, variables, and preview/debug mode

Custom events and custom conversions

Diagnosing inaccurate, duplicate, or misfiring conversion events

Mapping and tracking full paid acquisition funnels

GA4 or similar analytics tools

Landing page and funnel conversion optimization

Clear documentation of tracking architecture and event logic

 



The ideal candidate should be able to trace a conversion event from the ad click all the way through the landing page, form/application, booking system, CRM, and Meta Ads Manager reporting.



 



Must-Have Experience



You should have strong hands-on experience with:



Meta Ads Manager

Meta Pixel

Meta Conversions API

Google Tag Manager

Custom events and custom conversions

Event tracking and debugging

Browser-side vs server-side tracking

Event deduplication

GA4 or similar analytics tools

Paid funnel tracking and conversion optimization

 



Bonus skills:



Zapier: Designing automated workflows and integrations.

SEO: Managing technical on-page visibility.

AEO: Optimizing content for AI search.

 



 



You should be able to confidently answer questions like:



Why is Meta reporting conversions that did not actually happen?

Which button, page load, or server event is firing this conversion?

Is Meta optimizing toward the right action?

Are events duplicated, misfiring, or firing too early in the funnel?

 



Not a Fit If



This role is probably not right if you:



Only know basic campaign setup

Mainly focus on creatives, hooks, or audience testing

Cannot work confidently in Google Tag Manager

Have not debugged Pixel/CAPI issues before

Rely only on Ads Manager numbers without validating tracking accuracy

 



 



 



[[[ What You’ll Work On ]]]



 



You will help us:



Audit our current Meta Ads tracking setup

Diagnose incorrect or misleading conversion events

Fix or rebuild Meta Pixel, CAPI, and GTM tracking

Set up clean custom events and/or custom conversions

Ensure Meta is optimizing toward the correct conversion actions

Improve attribution and reporting accuracy

Track the full funnel from ad click to landing page to lead/application/booking

Identify funnel drop-off points and recommend improvements

Support future funnel buildouts across Meta, Google, and other paid channels

 



[[[ Availability & Logistics ]]]



 



- Time Zone: Commitment to work within or have significant overlap with the Pacific Standard Time (PST) zone.



- Platforms: Our team uses ClickUp, Slack, Sharepoint, Lastpass, Canva, and Hubstaff. Strong proficiency in these platforms is required.



 



[[[ Paid Test Job ]]]



 



We value your time and expertise. Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a Paid Test Job. This trial project will allow us to assess your technical skills, your ability to follow our specific SOPs, and your communication style within our asynchronous workflow (ClickUp/Slack).



 



 



We are looking for someone who can start by fixing our Meta tracking and attribution foundation, then potentially continue long-term as our technical funnel and performance marketing specialist.







Thank you for taking your time to complete this form. This helps us get to know you better and speeds up the hiring process. 







We thank all applicants for your interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.







Hope to welcome you to our team!

title: Project Manager / Coordinator & Estimator - Retail Fixtures (Full-Time Permanent)
description:
A B2B store buildout partner delivering complete retail store projects across Canada and the USA — fixtures, refrigeration, walk-ins, millwork, racking, and kitchen equipment, coordinated through one accountable team. Primary clients are grocery chains, pharmacies, hardware stores, and specialty retailers opening or expanding locations.



This is a full-time, fully remote position, starting on the estimating team.



You will build detailed cost estimates for retail store fixture projects — primarily gondola shelving and related store equipment. Each estimate starts from a customer's specifications and a store layout, and ends as a structured, spec-accurate quote ready for review.



Day to day, that means reading layouts and specifications, performing component-level takeoffs and dimensional math, retrieving cost pricing from manufacturer tools, applying per-project pricing formulas, and assembling the estimate in QuickBooks Online. You will flag missing information, request pricing from manufacturers where needed, and submit completed estimates for approval before they reach the customer.



Estimating happens within defined product systems and manufacturer pricing — the focus is accuracy and discipline, not invention. The role also sits alongside project coordination: tracking quotes through revision and approval, keeping specifications consistent, and coordinating with the sales lead and manufacturing partners. It reports to a senior tea
mber and has a clear path toward broader project responsibility for the right person.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



The trait that separates a strong estimator from an average one is accuracy under detail. A single wrong dimension or missed component flows straight into a quote and costs real money. We are looking for someone who treats spec accuracy as non-negotiable — who does the math twice, catches the gap before it ships, and flags an unknown instead of guessing it.



We also want someone who communicates with discipline — clear, direct, and proactive about surfacing problems early.



Candidates without real, hands-on estimating experience will not be considered.



REQUIREMENTS



1. Several years of hands-on cost estimating and quantity takeoff — reading drawings or layouts and translating them into priced, structured estimates. Background in construction, millwork, casework, or retail fixtures. Estimating limited to manufacturing unit costing or bill-of-materials work, with no takeoff from drawings, is not a fit for this role.



2. Strong dimensional and mathematical accuracy — comfort with component-level math, including depths, section counts, and run breakdowns, and the habit of checking work before it moves forward.



3. CAD literacy — able to read architectural floor plans and shop drawings. Experience with AutoCAD, SketchUp, or similar is expected.



4. Clear written English and disciplined communication — someone who flags assumptions and gaps rather than guessing, and coordinates cleanly across sales, manufacturers, and project staff.



5. Experience coordinating projects, schedules, or vendors alongside estimating work is a strong advantage. An engineering background — civil, structural, or architectural — is also a strong advantage.



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application review — form responses and resume are reviewed first.



2. A short interview — roughly 15 minutes, booked online



3. Second interview —around 30 minutes.



4.  Offer — extended to the candidate who passes all three stages.



TO APPLY



All applications are submitted through one form. Applications sent any other way may not be reviewed.







The form takes a few minutes and covers your experience, software, availability, and rate. Have your resume ready to upload.

Build dashboards in Looker Studio and Power BI against BigQuery-backed views and tables that we provide

Work from written specs (data source name, columns, visual type, filters, drill paths, target page layout) plus reference screenshots of legacy reports we are migrating

Match the look and behavior of existing client dashboards when rebuilding, or apply a clean default style when greenfield

Write the DAX measures and Looker Studio calculated fields needed for KPIs, YOY comparisons, and segment rollups

Iterate quickly on review feedback: add a column, swap a visual, fix a filter, change a sort

Flag spec gaps or data issues before building around them



What you do not do

You are not designing the data model. We hand you the BigQuery view or table, the field list, and the semantics. You build on top.

You are not the client point of contact. Reviews come through us.

Required

Strong production experience with both Looker Studio and Power BI (not just one)

Comfortable writing DAX measures: time intelligence (YOY, MTD, rolling), filter context, basic CALCULATE patterns

Comfortable connecting Power BI and Looker Studio to BigQuery as a data source, including parameterized connections and scheduled refresh

Reading and querying SQL at the level needed to sanity-check whether a number on your dashboard matches the source view

Reliable communication on Slack, fast turnaround on iteration cycles

Able to commit to at least 10 hours per week of focused dashboard work



Nice to have

Apparel, retail, ecommerce, or DTC reporting experience

Familiarity with rebuilding legacy Power BI files (.pbix) against new data sources

Experience with the Microsoft Fabric / Power BI Service workspace, gateways, and row-level security

dbt familiarity (you do not need to write dbt models, but understanding ref/source is a plus)



How we work

Specs and assets land in a shared folder per project. Each dashboard has a single owner on our side who answers questions and reviews iterations.

We expect short feedback loops: a first cut on a page within a couple of days, then revisions in hours, not days.

Invoicing monthly against tracked hours.



To apply

Send:

Two or three samples of dashboards you have built in each tool (Looker Studio and Power BI). Mock data is fine if real samples are confidential.

One paragraph on a project where you matched or rebuilt a legacy dashboard against a new data source. What broke, what you fixed.



Your hourly rate in USD or EUR and weekly availability.

title: GEO/SEO Virtual Assistant (Execution & Delivery)
description:
About us

We're an AI and SEO startup helping companies get found, not just on Google but on AI driven platforms like ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google's AI Overviews. This emerging field is called GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), and it's where search is heading. We work with growth minded businesses that want to stay visible as discovery shifts from blue links to AI answers. Founded by a serial entrepreneur who has built and scaled multiple ventures, the company is small, fast, and built for the new era of AI enabled search.

The role

This is a delivery and execution role. The strategy is handled. What we need is someone who makes sure the work actually ships: audits run on schedule, fixes get implemented, reports go out, and nothing slips through the cracks across a growing list of retainer clients.

You're detail oriented, technically strong, and the kind of person who finishes what they start and keeps systems running without being chased. You'll execute, audit, and improve technical SEO and GEO performance across multiple client sites, and you'll help build the workflows and SOPs that keep everything reproducible as we grow.

A new way of working

You'll work in a modern, AI first stack. We run client activity through Claude as our primary system of record, and we use Claude Code, Claude Cowork, SSH, and WP-CLI to do the actual GEO and SEO work. If that's new to you, good. I'll teach and train you in this new way of working while leaning hard on the SEO experience you already have. The one non-negotiable is that you're genuinely open to working differently.

Responsibilities



Run technical SEO and GEO audits using tools like Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Google Search Console, and GA4.

Identify and fix issues with crawlability, indexation, page speed, sitemaps, schema, and canonicalization.

Optimize site structure, internal linking, and Core Web Vitals.

Implement structured data and schema markup to improve visibility on both search engines and AI answer engines.

Support GEO and AEO work, optimizing client visibility on ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and AI Overviews.

Monitor rankings, traffic, and technical performance, and turn the data into clear summaries and recommendations.

Execute on-page and technical deliverables for client sites, on time, every time.

Document processes and maintain clean, reproducible workflows and SOPs.



Qualifications



4+ years of hands-on technical SEO experience (agency or freelance).

Strong with the core tools: Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, GA4, Google Search Console.

Solid grasp of HTML, XML sitemaps, schema.org, and core web technologies.

Comfortable in WordPress (Divi a plus) and familiar with other major CMS platforms.

Clear written communication and strong organizational skills.

Reliable and self-managing: you track your own commitments and hit deadlines without reminders.

Bonus: experience with AI search platforms, GEO/AEO strategy, or prompt writing.



Hours & compensation



Part-time to start: roughly 20 hours per week, with a clear path to full time as the client base grows.

Remote, flexible schedule.

Competitive hourly rate based on experience and results.



Why join



Direct access to the founder. You work with me, not through layers.

A front-row seat to GEO, the next frontier of search visibility.

Real ownership over systems and delivery from day one.

Core values that actually matter here: be kind to one another, be generous, and always be learning.



How to apply



Send 2 to 3 examples of technical SEO projects or audits you've worked on.

Include a short note on any experience with AI driven search (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity).

Share a screenshot of your Kolbe A result if you have one.

To show you read this all the way through, start your message with the word "Discovery," and tell me the one tool you'd reach for first on a brand-new audit and why.

title: Part time PPC Manager (Google & Bing Ads)
description:
Role Overview:

We are seeking an experienced PPC Manager to lead the development, execution, and optimization of paid search campaigns across both Google Ads and Bing Ads. The ideal candidate will have a hands-on understanding of both platforms and proven success managing large-scale, complex campaigns with significant budgets. You will be responsible for delivering results-driven campaigns that align with client goals while maintaining a deep understanding of industry best practices. Previous experience working at Google or a strong insider knowledge of Google Ads best practices is highly advantageous.

As a PPC Manager, you’ll be the go-to expert for all things paid search and will have a direct impact on client performance. The role requires a strategic mindset, data-driven decision-making, and the ability to maintain clear and effective communication with both internal teams and clients.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Paid Search Strategy & Execution:

Campaign Development & Management: Develop, launch, and manage paid search campaigns on Google Ads and Bing Ads, ensuring they are aligned with client objectives and maximize ROI. This includes campaigns on Google Search, Display, YouTube, Shopping, and Bing Search.

Keyword Research & Audience Targeting: Conduct extensive keyword research, competitor analysis, and audience segmentation to identify growth opportunities. Develop comprehensive strategies based on these insights to optimize targeting and bidding.

Campaign Optimization: Continuously analyze and refine campaigns to improve performance metrics such as CPC, CTR, CPA, and ROAS. Implement A/B testing strategies for ad creatives, landing pages, and bidding strategies to maximize conversions.

Ad Copy & Creative Strategy: Work closely with the creative team to ensure that ad copy, creatives, and landing pages are optimized for user engagement and aligned with campaign goals.

2. Client Communication & Consultation:

Client Liaison: Serve as the main point of contact for clients, providing expert consultation on all Google Ads and Bing Ads strategies. Clearly communicate campaign progress, adjustments, and results to ensure client satisfaction and alignment with business objectives.

Performance Reporting: Regularly prepare and present in-depth performance reports, including key performance metrics (CPC, CTR, CPA, ROAS) and actionable insights. Use these reports to showcase campaign successes and provide strategic recommendations for optimization.

Strategic Guidance: Offer strategic recommendations to clients, advising on how to improve campaign performance, expand reach, or address performance challenges. Proactively identify opportunities for growth.

Client Relationship Management: Build and nurture strong relationships with clients, becoming a trusted advisor on paid search and digital marketing. Ensure high levels of client satisfaction, resolve campaign-related issues, and manage client expectations effectively.

3. Budget Management & Performance Tracking:

Budget Oversight: Manage and optimize client budgets across both Google Ads and Bing Ads to ensure campaigns are efficient and within budget. Track and report on budget pacing and ensure that client goals are met while maximizing ROI.

Performance Tracking & Analysis: Utilize Google Analytics, Microsoft Advertising Intelligence, Google Tag Manager, and other analytics platforms to monitor campaign performance in real time. Assess KPIs such as CPC, CTR, CPA, and ROAS to ensure campaigns are delivering results within the defined parameters.

Optimization: Make data-driven decisions to optimize campaigns for better performance. Adjust bids, keywords, targeting, and ads based on performance trends and competitive insights.

4. Collaboration & Cross-Functional Alignment:

Team Collaboration: Work closely with the broader digital marketing team (SEO, Social Media, Creative, Web Development) to ensure that PPC campaigns are integrated into wider marketing and sales strategies. Align campaigns with broader business objectives, ensuring a cohesive approach across all digital channels.

Stakeholder Coordination: Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure paid search efforts align with company goals and support sales or product launch strategies.

Knowledge Sharing: Actively contribute to knowledge-sharing within the marketing team by educating peers about PPC best practices, emerging trends, and new tools or features in Google Ads and Bing Ads.

5. Industry Trend Awareness & Innovation:

Stay Current with PPC Trends: Stay up-to-date with the latest Google Ads and Bing Ads updates, features, and best practices. Attend webinars, conferences, and industry events to keep ahead of emerging trends and leverage new opportunities for clients.

Test New Strategies: Continuously evaluate and experiment with new tools, bidding strategies, and ad formats to ensure campaigns are always optimized and competitive. Propose new strategies to clients based on these findings.

6. Reporting & Data-Driven Insights:

Regular Reporting: Create and maintain regular performance reports, dashboards, and presentations to track campaign progress, analyze performance trends, and showcase ROI. Present these findings in a clear, concise manner to clients and internal teams.

Actionable Insights: Translate complex data into actionable insights that drive campaign improvements. Provide clear, data-backed recommendations to both internal and client stakeholders to guide future PPC strategies and decisions.

Attribution & Conversion Tracking: Implement and manage proper tracking systems to measure campaign effectiveness and provide accurate reporting on conversions, revenue, and other key metrics.



Qualifications:

Education:

Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Certifications in Google Ads and Bing Ads are a plus.



Experience:

Proven PPC Experience: Minimum of 3–5 years of hands-on experience managing PPC campaigns across Google Ads and Bing Ads. This includes experience in Google Search, Display, YouTube, Shopping, and Bing Search campaigns.

Agency or Client Experience: Experience working in a client-facing role, ideally in a digital marketing agency, managing multiple PPC accounts with large-scale budgets.

Experience at Google (Bonus): Previous experience working at Google or within a Google Partner agency is highly desirable, particularly if you have in-depth knowledge of Google Ads best practices, new features, and insights from working directly with the platform.



Technical Skills:

Google Ads & Bing Ads Expertise: Advanced proficiency in managing campaigns across Google Ads and Bing Ads, including search, display, shopping, remarketing, and video campaigns.

Analytics Tools Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of Google Analytics, Microsoft Advertising Intelligence, Google Tag Manager, and other relevant analytics and tracking tools to measure, report, and optimize PPC campaign performance.

Data Interpretation: Ability to analyze large datasets, interpret complex data, and turn insights into actionable strategies to optimize campaign performance.



Soft Skills:

Excellent Communication & Presentation Skills: Ability to explain complex PPC strategies and performance data in a clear, concise, and accessible manner for clients, internal teams, and stakeholders.

Client Management Experience: Proven experience in building and nurturing strong client relationships. Ability to manage client expectations and resolve issues in a timely and professional manner.

Problem-Solving & Proactive Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to identifying and addressing campaign issues. Ability to think critically and take strategic action based on data.

Attention to Detail: High attention to detail, ensuring that campaign elements are precise and accurately reflect client objectives, even when working with large volumes of data.



How to Apply:

If you’re an experienced PPC Manager looking for a new challenge, we want to hear from you! Please submit your resume, along with a cover letter outlining your relevant experience. Include any specific campaigns or achievements that highlight your expertise with Google Ads and Bing Ads.

We are looking for a versatile creative who is equally talented at clean graphic design layouts and creating original digital illustrations from scratch (such as stickers, vectors, posters, logos, and branding).

- Excellent command of layout, typography, and visual hierarchy (experience with educational materials or handbooks is a big plus).

- Ability to translate complex or abstract educational concepts into engaging, kid- and parent-friendly visual assets.

- Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the flexibility to juggle multiple active projects.

- Fluent in English with the ability to assist in proofreading graphic copy.

to $50K/month, then $100K, then $500K.

? Sees what's broken before being asked

Experience with AI-generated b-roll (Higgsfield, Runway, Sora) for ad creative



Logistics

title: CCM Chronic Care Mgmt
description:
A Certified Case Manager (CCM) or Chronic Care Management (CCM) Specialist coordinates and oversees patient care for individuals with complex medical needs. They assess patient needs, develop comprehensive care plans, and ensure healthcare services are seamlessly managed.A CCM’s core duties and responsibilities are broken down into the following key areas:

1. Care Planning and CoordinationDevelop Care Plans: Create and update personalized care plans for patients with multiple chronic conditions, ensuring all health and social goals are addressed.Multidisciplinary Collaboration: Act as a central point of contact between patients, primary care physicians, medical specialists, and social workers.Referral and Order Tracking: Monitor lab results, imaging, and specialist referrals in Electronic Health Records (EHR) to ensure timely care delivery.

2. Patient Outreach and EducationRoutine Check-ins: Conduct regular, often monthly, outbound phone calls (typically at least 20 minutes) to check in on patient progress, medication adherence, and health goals.Symptom Triage: Assess patient calls or concerns and determine the best course of action (e.g., scheduling a doctor's visit, escalating to a provider, or directing to the ER).Education & Coaching: Provide self-management education, disease prevention strategies, and guidance on navigating complex healthcare systems.

3. Resource Navigation & AdvocacyBarrier Mitigation: Identify and resolve obstacles to care—such as lack of transportation, financial difficulties, or unstable housing—by connecting patients with appropriate community resources.Insurance Assistance: Assist with insurance authorizations, ensure cost-effective treatment options, and help individuals access public benefits.

4. Documentation and ComplianceRegulatory Adherence: Ensure all care management services meet infection control guidelines, patient privacy/HIPAA policies, and medical billing standards.Detailed Record-Keeping: Thoroughly document patient interactions, assessments, and care plan modifications within the EHR system.

title: TikTok Shop Operations Specialist - Backend & Seller Center (Remote)
description:
We are hiring a TikTok Shop Operations Specialist for our client, a TikTok-native agency that manages TikTok Shop growth for global brands including Gymshark, Duolingo, Shopify, Amazon, Converse, Notion, and Victoria's Secret. Our client manages $250M+ in ad spend per year and works with 100+ active clients.



This is a backend operations role. You will be the person who makes Seller Center work - setting up shops, managing product listings, handling compliance, and keeping every shop running smoothly while the activation team focuses on growth.

This is NOT a strategy, creative, or content role. It is hands-on, detail-heavy, and operational.



What You Will Do:



- Full TikTok Shop setup from A to Z: brand verification, product verification, shipping, tax, returns, and catalogue structure

- Create, upload, and optimise product listings. Fix listing errors and resolve suppressions

- Enrol products into TikTok campaigns (flash deals, seasonal promotions, vouchers) and troubleshoot eligibility issues

- Monitor Seller Performance Score, identify compliance risks, submit appeals, and manage resolution

- Troubleshoot backend issues: listing errors, payment and payout problems, shipping discrepancies

- Support TikTok Shop affiliate programmes - product mapping, commission setup, and performance tracking

- Work closely with the Activation Lead, Affiliate Team, and Client Success Managers

- Deliver clear daily and weekly reports on shop status, listings, and campaign participation



Must-Have Requirements:



- 1–2+ years of hands-on TikTok Shop experience, including full shop setups from scratch

- Direct experience with brand and product verification processes and compliance appeals

- Strong troubleshooting skills inside Seller Center - you know where to look and how to fix it

- Experience supporting TikTok Shop affiliate programmes (product mapping, commission setup)

- Excellent attention to detail - nothing slips through

- Proficient in Google Sheets / Excel

- Comfortable using project management tools (ClickUp or similar)

- Strong written English

- Comfortable managing multiple brands and shifting priorities at the same time



Nice to Have:



-Previous agency experience

- Familiarity with TikTok Shop in multiple regions (UK, US, EU, SEA)



You Will Thrive Here If:



- You think in systems and enjoy keeping things running smoothly behind the scenes

- You catch errors and inconsistencies before anyone else does

- You work independently - give you the task and deadline, and it gets done

- You enjoy figuring out the root cause when something breaks

You want to deepen your expertise in TikTok commerce



This Role Is NOT For You If:



- You prefer strategy or creative work over execution

- You need detailed instructions for every task

- You find repetitive backend work tedious

- You want a client-facing role

title: Full Stack Developer (Builder) — Claude Code First
description:
Who we are

We're a multi-brand DTC e-commerce operation running ~10 Shopify stores across European and international markets. We build fast, ship constantly, and own our entire stack: storefronts, custom backends, integrations, and the internal tooling that keeps everything moving.

We're looking for a builder who works Claude Code first. For us that's not a perk or a side tool — it's the primary way we develop. You should be the kind of engineer who reaches for Claude Code by default to ship a wide range of things: apps, websites, skills, automations, and internal tools. We care less about which lane you came from and more about how much you can build and how fast you can ship it well.

What you'll build



Apps — customer-facing and internal: storefront features, dashboards, upsell and referral systems, customer-service tooling

Websites — custom Shopify themes (Liquid, OS 2.0, Dawn-based) and standalone sites across multiple brands and locales

Skills — reusable Claude Code skills and agents that scale how the whole team builds and operates

Automations — workflows that connect our marketing, ops, and sales tooling and remove manual work

Tools — the internal utilities that make everyone around you faster



All of it driven through Claude Code — building agentic workflows, structuring projects so the AI is effective, and reviewing/hardening output before it ships.

What we're looking for



Claude Code as your main development tool. Daily fluency: clear prompting, agentic workflows, building reusable skills, structuring repos and tasks so the AI is productive, and the judgment to review and correct what it produces

Strong JavaScript/TypeScript across the stack (Node.js + React)

Real Shopify experience — Liquid, theme architecture, OS 2.0, and the Admin/Storefront APIs

Comfort with PostgreSQL, building/consuming REST APIs, and deploying on Railway / Vercel

A genuine builder's bias toward shipping — you can take a loose spec and turn it into something live, then iterate

Self-directed, direct in communication, and able to own projects end to end



Nice to have



Experience with multi-store / multi-market Shopify setups

Familiarity with DTC / paid-social-driven e-commerce

A track record of building automations, internal tools, or AI-assisted workflows

Comfort working in English
